items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Starring Bob Hope, Mickey Rooney, Jimmy Durante and Judy Garland" -- and with that Daniels boy... All them people.

ctx.x: going from here...from here in Nevada, and they're going from St. Louis to Chicago to New York City to Madison Square Garden. This is the greatest show ever done, old-time, old-fashioned medicine show, featuring the sensational product, Hadicol. Starring Bob Hope, Mickey Rooney, Jimmy Durante and Judy Garland" -- and with that Daniels boy, that little young boy that's like Mickey Rooney. All them people. And Jerry Corona(?). They had all of Bob Hope's people and Jimmy Durante and all that's coming to the Garden.…
I said, "Mmm, wait til he comes to the Madison Square Garden. I'm going out there and check him." They ain't got a first(?) Black star nowhere. No artist at all.
